summary: Validity of arrest under Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.19; mandatory recording of "reasons to believe" before arrest; arrest grounds must strictly comply with Article 22(1) Constitution safeguards; failure to record written reasons renders arrest illegal; High Court rejection of writ petition challenging arrest quashed; interim protection granted pending trial court re-evaluation.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.19
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; appellant granted interim protection from arrest until trial court determines compliance with s.19 safeguards.
